meta.title: Endrika sy modely chatbot — ONIR CMS
meta.description: Modely hita maso ONIR CMS: Immersive, Starter, Natural World, MandamPro, Nuit & Jade, Atelier Paper, Pop Design, Nutriva ary Puzzle. Malalaka, vonona ampidirina.
meta.ogTitle: Endrika sy modely chatbot — ONIR CMS
meta.ogDescription: Alaivo ny modely hita maso ONIR CMS.

hero.title: Endrika azonao ampiasaina
hero.lead: Azonao atao ny manovanova ny endrikin'ny assistant IA araka izay endriny tianao, azonao atao ihany koa ny mampamorona endriny vaovao
hero.freeNote: Malalaka avokoa ny endrika rehetra ankehitriny.

items.name: Immersive
items.description: Sehatra 3D feno: trano fidirana, efitrano, avatar, album, resaka tari-dalana ary fampidirana rakitra.
items.detailsText: Modely ofisialy misy assets CC0. Sehatra 3D, avatar TalkingHead, album, fahalalana, media, fandrindrana rohy ary rakitra (CV, antontan-taratasy).
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: Starter
items.description: Ny modely fototra: taratasy fanamarinana, resaka ary media.
items.detailsText: Ny modely fototra misy cursor fanaraha-maso: lohapejy, fandraisana, resaka, mpandefa ary launcher.
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: Natural World
items.author: Rinoheinrich
items.description: Sehatra voajanahary manintona: sary lehibe, iraka, vokatra, fijoroana vavolombelona ary resaka tafiditra.
items.detailsText: Modely ofisialy ONIR CMS. Pejy voajanahary misy fizarana iraka, vokatra sy fijoroana vavolombelona, pejy ara-dalàna ary resaka tafiditra. Mifanaraka amin’ny cursor fanaraha-maso hanasivana ny variables isaky ny faritra.

items.name: MandamPro
items.description: Resaka ho an’ny besinimaro misy endrika ChatGPT: taratasy, hafatra, fikarohana fiche ary media.
items.detailsText: Modely ho an’ny besinimaro MandamPro, UI-only, maneho blocs fikarohana, media ary saha voafaritra.
items.author: Rinoheinrich

items.name: Nuit & Jade
items.author: Anjary
items.description: Resaka tsara tarehy miloko alina, jade sy cobalt: karatra boribory, avatar ary sehatra pejy + widget.
items.detailsText: Modely ONIR CMS noforonin’i Anjary. Charte Man-Dam Pro: alina, jade sy cobalt, karatra fotsy, bokotra pill, avatar ary fampisehoana hafatra, media sy valin’ny fikarohana.

items.name: Atelier Paper
items.author: Anjary
items.description: Modely taratasy mainty sy fotsy, misy encoches sy soratra monospace, ho an’ny resaka editorial tsotra.
items.detailsText: Modely ONIR CMS noforonin’i Anjary. Design « Spin Product »: karatra fotsy misy encoches, accent mainty, soratra monospace, sehatra pejy sy widget.

items.name: Pop Design
items.author: Anjary
items.description: Modely pop immersive: lohape misy sary, fizarana voarindra, galerie media ary karatra mpikambana.
items.detailsText: Modely ONIR CMS noforonin’i Anjary. Fizarana voasokajy (card, text, image, grid, form), andraikitra malalaka, karatra mpikambana, galerie photothèque ary fampisehoana hafatra.

items.name: Nutriva
items.author: Rabalantome
items.description: Modely editora misy pejy maromaro, miovaova arakaraka ny efijery, misy fifehezana fiainana manokana mifanaraka amin'ny loko ary azo ampiasaina amin'ny fitendry.
items.detailsText: Modely ONIR CMS noforonin'i Rabalantome. Sehatra editora misy pejy maromaro ho an'ny Nutriva : sary vokatra lehibe, pejy Discover, Nutrition sy Support, galerie, horonan-tsary, fifehezana fiainana manokana ary resaka tafiditra.

items.name: Puzzle
items.author: ONIRTECH
items.description: Moteur fanamboarana pejy sy resaka : pejy, faritra zaraina, bolongana, placements, actions ary style azo ovaina.
items.detailsText: Template ofisialy ONIR CMS. Structure feno amin'ny pejy, faritra, bolongana, placements, actions ary profil style, miaraka amin'ny inspection isaky ny component sy ny contrat Editor V2.
